{{Quote|I pay for speed and expertise. You can calibrate Caldorf VII and Regginis Mol interceptor missiles? I pay two hundred per missile mounted and calibrated. Do you wish the job?''"<br />"''Yes. Where and when? And what do we call you?''"<br />"''Call me Ranquiv. We leave at once.|"Ranquiv" and Han Solo|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
A [[Storm-hair]] assuming the name "'''Ranquiv'''" was the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of a [[Poln Minor Chosen squadron|squadron]] of [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], the [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] of the Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and his [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the warlord dispatched Ranquiv and his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]], commanding the warriors to arm fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s&mdash;which they hid in a [[Ranquiv's cavern|cavern]]&mdash;with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s.

Ranquiv hired several beings, including the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to help his forces arm the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. While they did so, Ranquiv's troops walked toward the Rebels, who feared that they would not be able to leave the cavern without the Chosen commander's permission, commandeering a Whisperlike to escape; however, Solo crashed the starfighter and stole a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]] Ranquiv was using to transport his workers to the [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] and escaped. Shortly after, the Storm-hairs launched their [[Starship/Legends|starfighters]] during a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] between Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] and Ranquiv's Whisperlikes and the forces of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Solo destroyed the Storm-hair's starfighters with a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan One]] [[Space station/Legends|space station's]] [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]. Thrawn's forces destroyed the Eastern Fleet, forcing Esva to flee.

==Biography==
===The Chosen's whispers===
{{Quote|An unusual person has been scouring the city for knowledgeable workers who will accept payment and not speak afterward of what they've seen.|A Duros, on "Ranquiv"|<ref name="Choices of One " />}}
[[File:Thrawn-TCGboxart.png|thumb|right|300px|"Ranquiv" armed Whisperlikes as part of the Storm-hair preparations for a battle against Thrawn (pictured).]]
A [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> assuming the name of "Ranquiv" served the Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and his [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]] as a [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]] of the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], Esva's elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]].<ref name="Choices of One" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the warlord dispatched a [[Poln Minor Chosen squadron|squadron]] of Chosen under Ranquiv's command to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Minor]]&mdash;which was located in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], which also contained the planet [[Poln Major]]. He tasked the contingent with arming fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]]s with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s as part of the Storm-hair's preparations for a battle against his nemesis, [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

Ranquiv and his forces hid their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in a [[Ranquiv's cavern|cavern]], using a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speeder bus]] as [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. The Storm-hair commander brought several workers, who promised not to speak of what they saw after their work arming Whisperlikes was finished, from Poln Minor's [[Dankcamp Village]] to the cavern. As another [[Poln Major Chosen squadron|squadron]] of Chosen [[Battle for Poln Major|attempted]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]], the Poln [[Star system/Legends|system's]] governor, the Chosen on Poln Minor armed the Whisperlikes.<ref name="Choices of One" />

===Death among the Chosen===
{{Quote|The frilty little bittern took them down. Every last frilting one of them.''"<br />"''Then send in more. You said you would bring enough.''"<br />"''Numbers aren't the problem. The problem is, no one else can get into the palace until our man inside comes out of wherever he's hiding.|"Spikes" and "Ranquiv"|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:Choices_of_One.jpg|thumb|left|300px|"Ranquiv" discussed the Poln Major Chosen squadron's efforts on Poln Major (pictured).]]
At Poln Minor's [[Capperling's Cantina]], a [[Unidentified Duros (Poln Minor)|Duros]] criminal introduced Ranquiv to two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Solo introduced himself and the princess as Shrike and Payne, respectively, as Solo did not want to tell Ranquiv their true names. Seeking to know if the pair could help him, Ranquiv asked them if they could calibrate Caldorf and [[Regginis Mol interceptor missile]]s, as any [[Missile/Legends|missile]] [[Programmer/Legends|programmer]] would know that the model's construction had ceased [[19 BBY/Legends|twenty years ago]]. Organa remarked that the missiles' construction had ceased, satisfying Ranquiv, who invited the pair to his [[Cave/Legends|cavern]]. He offered them twenty hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] per missile mounted and calibrated.<ref name="Choices of One" />

After the group arrived at the cave, Ranquiv, a [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] known as "[[Spikes]]," and several Chosen discussed the Poln Major Chosen squadron's attempts on Ferrouz's life. The thug told Ranquiv that [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] had destroyed most of the squadron and that no one could get into Ferrouz's [[Whitestone City palace|palace]] until one of Esva's agents, [[Vestin Axlon]], left the building. Solo interrupted the conversation and requested more bolts, which the Storm-hair commander provided.<ref name="Choices of One" />

===Going out with a bang===
{{Quote|Commander, I have ships at the explosion region. Looks like they're rising out from underground. Midsized fighters, alien design, with underslung&mdash; Commander, those underslung missiles are ''Caldorf VII interceptors''.|The [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera''{{'s}}]] [[Sensor officer/Legends|sensor officer]], to [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] commander|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
[[File:Daric_Allegiance.jpg|thumb|right|300px|While he dealt with the Hand of Judgment (pictured), Vestin Axlon told Dors Stelikag to tell "Ranquiv" about Solo.]]
Shortly after, Ranquiv, several Chosen warriors, and two [[Gender/Legends|men]] walked to the Whisperlike the Rebels were working on. As the operatives feared that they could not leave the cave unless Ranquiv permitted them to do so, they commandeered the [[Starship/Legends|starfighter]] and moved to escape. As Ranquiv and his men approached the Whisperlike, Solo threw a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]] at Ranquiv, who protected his face with his [[Limb/Legends|forearms]]. The Rebels then crashed their fighter and escaped aboard the Chosen commander's speeder bus. The Chosen attempted to track down the Rebels but ultimately failed. Shortly afterward, Axlon, who had captured the [[Hand of Judgment]]&mdash;a group of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]] of the Empire&mdash;told the thug [[Dors Stelikag]] that he should tell Ranquiv about Solo, whom Axlon believed would not be a problem.<ref name="Choices of One" />

As the Hand of Judgment and Jade eliminated the Chosen squadron on Poln Major, a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] between Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] and Ranquiv's Whisperlikes and Thrawn's Imperial forces erupted in the Poln system. The Storm-hair starfighters attempted to destroy the senior captain's<ref name="Choices of One" /> [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref> ''[[Admonitor]]''; however, Solo commandeered a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan One]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and used its [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] to destroy the Whisperlikes. Thrawn destroyed the rest of Esva's forces, and the warlord fled.<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ranquiv's heading this way. He's got two armed men with him. ''"<br />"''On a scale of one to ten, how unhappy do they look?''"<br />"''Very. There are two more men and two more of Ranquiv's yellow-eyed friends coming in about ten meters behind them.|Leia Organa and Han Solo|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
Ranquiv and his men were angry while chasing Organa and Solo, according to the former Rebel. A Storm-hair, the Chosen commander had skin that shimmered like a rainbow, and [[Color/Legends|yellow]],<ref name="Choices of One" /> multifaceted<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Ranquiv's voice was as shimmery as his skin, with clipped edges to his words.<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Equipment==
Ranquiv wore a [[Clothing/Legends|hood]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ranquiv appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', which was written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
